The Star Bottle Glass Goal Widget is an animated liquid fill goal tracker shaped like a slim glass bottle of stars, built for Twitch streamers who want a clean, minimal overlay that still reads at a glance.

What You Get

  • Starbottlegoalcode.zip, the widget code, uploaded as a custom widget
  • HowToSetupGoalWidgetTutorial.pdf, the step by step setup guide

Works With

  • Twitch, the platform this widget tracks activity for
  • StreamElements, the platform this widget is built and installed through
  • Streamlabs Desktop, where the widget can be displayed as a browser source
  • OBS Studio, shown as a browser source

Setup

  1. Open the included setup guide (HowToSetupGoalWidgetTutorial.pdf) for full instructions.
  2. Unzip the widget code and add it as a custom widget in StreamElements.
  3. Set the goal type (donation, follower, bits or support), colour, font, and font size in the widget's custom fields.
  4. Add the widget to your scene in OBS Studio or Streamlabs Desktop as a browser source.

Setup is manual and takes about 10 to 15 minutes.

Customizable

  • Colour, to match your channel's branding
  • Font and font size
  • Goal type, choose between donation, follower, bits or support

FAQ

What software do I need to use the Star Bottle Glass Goal Widget?

You need a free StreamElements account to set up the widget and either OBS Studio or Streamlabs Desktop to show it on your Twitch stream as a browser source.

Does this work with Streamlabs?

The widget itself is built as a StreamElements custom widget. You can display it in Streamlabs Desktop or OBS Studio as a browser source, but the download does not include a separate Streamlabs widget build.

Can I change the colours and font?

Yes. The Star Bottle Glass Goal Widget colour, font, and font size are all customizable so it can match your channel's branding.

What goal types can I track?

The Star Bottle Glass Goal Widget supports donation, follower, bits and support goals, and you pick which one it tracks in the widget's settings.

Is this a physical product?

No. This is a digital download only. Nothing physical is shipped, and the files are for your own personal stream use, not for redistribution or resale.
